title: Autonomous testing with Jira and BearQ
summary: Meet BearQ for Jira, the autonomous AI testing agent that maps user journeys, adapts test suites in real time, and helps engineering teams scale QA capacity.
body_markdown:
**Close the loop between the code your team builds and the quality you ship by bringing an intelligent, assignable agent directly into your Jira workflow.**


Today, teams are caught between high-maintenance test suites that break easily and generic AI tools that lack delivery context. When testing is disconnected from where work is planned, teams lose sight of user journeys, acceptance criteria, and release scope. The result is blind spots, late-stage defects, noisy test suites, and costly handoffs across product, engineering, and QA.


Getting quality right in an AI-native delivery cycle requires grounding testing in the requirements and decisions your team collaborates on every day.


That’s where **BearQ for Jira** comes in.


BearQ is an assignable agent that brings intelligent, end-to-end testing directly into the delivery workflow. Acting as an AI teammate assigned to Jira work items, BearQ explores user journeys, generates adaptive test coverage, catches defects early, and closes the loop between the code agents write and the quality your team delivers.


## How it works


### Ground testing in real delivery context


Traditional testing often starts with disconnected tickets, stale specs, or clunky handoffs. BearQ flips this model by turning Jira work items into living test context.


Once code is generated and a PR or preview environment is ready, assign the work item directly to BearQ or @mention BearQ in Rovo Chat to start testing. BearQ instantly parses acceptance criteria, technical requirements, and comment threads to author test cases, document reproduction steps, and actively explore browser behavior. Whether Rovo leads initial triage or BearQ jumps straight into validation, quality assurance stays embedded directly in your flow of work – eliminating manual context gathering and costly handoffs.


### Adapt tests as your application evolves


Fast-moving product teams shouldn’t be held back by static scripts. As features iterate and workflows shift, maintaining brittle test scripts becomes a full-time job.


Powered by real-time Jira context, BearQ autonomously explores and maps your application, discovering untested user paths and edge cases that scripted tests miss. Because it generates tests that dynamically adapt as application behavior changes, delivery teams can catch regressions before staging and move from planned changes to validated results in minutes rather than days.


### **Scale QA capacity without losing control**


Expand your testing footprint without sacrificing trust or governance. BearQ acts as an autonomous teammate, exploring and validating across your application, while your team sets the guardrails, directs focus, and retains oversight where it matters most.


When BearQ finds regressions, UX issues, or data inconsistencies, it creates actionable Jira issues with reproduction steps and evidence. Less time spent triaging means faster feedback, quicker resolution, and more time for QA to focus on high-impact risk.


# Availability


[BearQ for Jira](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/56475305/bearq-for-jira?hosting=cloud&tab=overview) is available on the Atlassian Marketplace. Connect BearQ to your Jira workspace today to bring testing and delivery together into a unified, agent-orchestrated workflow.
